name.value: Best Western Plus Country Meadows Inn

description.value: The Best Western Plus Country Meadows is a full-service hotel in Aldergrove, BC, situated in the Fraser Valley between Langley and Abbotsford, about 45 minutes from Vancouver. Independently owned and operated by a family-run hospitality group with eight properties across BC and Alberta, the hotel features an indoor pool, fitness centre, and a variety of room types including Jacuzzi suites and accessible rooms. An on-site White Spot restaurant and complimentary hot breakfast make it a practical overnight base for touring cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley corridor.

raw_osm.name: Best Western Plus Country Meadows Inn

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms this is an active Best Western Plus hotel at 3070 264th Street in Aldergrove, BC (OSM tags the city as Langley, which is the broader Township municipality). The site confirms free wireless internet access, a complimentary hot breakfast, an indoor pool and fitness centre, and an on-site White Spot Restaurant, but contains no mention of bike storage, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities. OSM has no phone number on record, but the website consistently lists 604-856-9880.
concerns: OSM addr:city is 'Langley' but the website consistently identifies the location as 'Aldergrove' (Aldergrove is a community within the Township of Langley — both can be technically correct, but the postal address on the website uses Aldergrove). Address contact_confirmed set to false on this basis.
OSM phone field is empty; phone number 604-856-9880 sourced from website only and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible hotel with a functioning website and confirmed amenities; useful to touring cyclists as an overnight stop in the Fraser Valley.
